test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Which route / on the highway / have been blocked / by the police?
solution:
The erroneous part is option 4), i.e., 'have been blocked.'
